description.zh: 配置ID。
description.en: The configuration ID.

description.zh: 改写回源请求的DNS解析记录。
description.en: Overrides the DNS record for the origin request.

description.zh:
回源302跟随开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Indicates whether to follow 302 redirects for origin requests. Valid values:

- `on`: Follows 302 redirects.

- `off`: Does not follow 302 redirects.

description.zh: 302跟随次数上限，取值范围[1-5]。
description.en: The maximum number of 302 redirects to follow. The value must be an integer from 1 to 5.

description.zh:
保留原始请求参数开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Indicates whether to retain the original request parameters when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the parameters.

- `off`: Does not retain the parameters.

description.zh:
保留原始请求头开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Indicates whether to retain the original request headers when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the headers.

- `off`: Does not retain the headers.

description.zh: 修改302后的回源host。
description.en: The `Host` header for the redirected origin request.

description.zh: 回源请求中携带的HOST。
description.en: The `Host` header for the origin request.

description.zh: 使用HTTP协议回源时访问的源站端口。
description.en: The origin server port for HTTP requests.

description.zh: 使用HTTPS协议回源时访问的源站端口。
description.en: The origin server port for HTTPS requests.

description.zh:
mtls开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Indicates whether to enable mutual TLS (mTLS) for origin requests. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables mTLS.

- `off`: Disables mTLS.

description.zh: 源站读超时时间（秒）。
description.en: The read timeout period for the origin server, in seconds.

description.zh:
回源请求使用的协议。取值范围：
- http：使用HTTP协议回源。
- https：使用HTTPS协议回源。
- follow：跟随客户端协议回源。
description.en:
The protocol for origin requests. Valid values:

- `http`: The origin request uses HTTP.

- `https`: The origin request uses HTTPS.

- `follow`: The origin request uses the same protocol as the client request.

description.zh: 回源请求中携带的SNI。
description.en: The Server Name Indication (SNI) for the origin request.

description.zh:
源站证书校验开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Indicates whether to enable origin certificate verification. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables verification.

- `off`: Disables verification.

description.zh:
使用range分片方式回源下载文件。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
- force：强制。
description.en:
Indicates whether to use range requests when fetching files from the origin server. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables range requests.

- `off`: Disables range requests.

- `force`: Enforces range requests.

description.zh:
range分片大小。取值范围：
- 512KB
- 1MB
- 2MB
- 4MB
description.en:
The size of each chunk for range requests. Valid values:

- 512KB

- 1MB

- 2MB

- 4MB

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true。
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")。
description.en:
The rule content, which is a conditional expression that matches user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`.

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Indicates whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables the rule.

- `off`: Disables the rule.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The execution priority of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.

title.zh: 修改站点回源规则配置
title.en: Modify Origin Rule Configuration for Site

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-origin-rule --site-id 54074984130000 --config-id 352816096980000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --origin-host origin.example.com --origin-scheme http --origin-sni origin.example.com --dns-record test.example.com --origin-http-port 8080 --origin-https-port 4433 --range on --origin-mtls on --origin-verify on --range-chunk-size 1MB --sequence 1 --origin-read-timeout 10 --follow-302-enable on --follow-302-max-tries 1 --follow-302-retain-args on --follow-302-retain-header on --follow-302-target-host test.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateOriginRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 54074984130000 --Follow302MaxTries 1 --RuleEnable on --OriginHttpsPort 4433 --Follow302RetainArgs on --OriginScheme http --Sequence 1 --Follow302RetainHeader on --Range on --RangeChunkSize 1MB --OriginReadTimeout 10 --OriginHost 'origin.example.com' --OriginHttpPort 8080 --OriginMtls on --Follow302TargetHost 'test.com' --OriginSni 'origin.example.com' --ConfigId 352816096980000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --DnsRecord 'test.example.com' --Follow302Enable on --RuleName rule_example --OriginVerify on
